cases.title: Single-route bottleneck
cases.scenario: Three serial edges bound throughput.
cases.oracle: Single path throughput is the minimum edge capacity; unmet demand is demand minus delivered.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Two alternative rail/road paths
cases.scenario: Two edge-disjoint paths connect source and destination.
cases.oracle: Parallel independent path capacities sum to 45; demand caps delivered flow.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Multimodal chain bottleneck
cases.scenario: A cargo chain is limited by its least-capacity stage.
cases.oracle: End-to-end chain throughput is the minimum of demand and each stage.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Staged rail commissioning with overlap
cases.scenario: New rail capacity is commissioned before old capacity is retired.
cases.oracle: Per period delivered is min(demand, old capacity plus new capacity).
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Premature retirement before new capacity
cases.scenario: Old service retires before planned new capacity is actually commissioned.
cases.oracle: The service gap is one period with unmet demand 80.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Two nominal paths share a power substation
cases.scenario: Separate route geometries both require one common power/control node.
cases.oracle: Failure of the required common dependency disables both nominal paths.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Single-path outage with surviving alternate path
cases.scenario: One of two physically independent paths becomes unavailable.
cases.oracle: Only the surviving road path contributes capacity.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Planned terminal capacity not operating capacity
cases.scenario: A masterplan capacity is not evidenced as commissioned.
cases.oracle: Capacity class and commissioning status are mandatory; planned capacity remains a future scenario.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Announced future train operator start date
cases.scenario: A future service start is announced but observed operation evidence is absent.
cases.oracle: A future plan does not establish present operation.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Road and rail share a flood footprint
cases.scenario: Two route geometries intersect one event footprint.
cases.oracle: Spatially shared exposure is a common hazard relation, not independent event draws.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Separate terminals share control plane
cases.scenario: Multiple terminals rely on a common control/telemetry dependency.
cases.oracle: Nominal terminal count does not imply independent digital control.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Alternative gateway requires cargo compatibility
cases.scenario: A candidate gateway is not credited until key capabilities are evidenced.
cases.oracle: A different port name is not proof of a usable alternative gateway.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Canal or transfer unsupported without catchment evidence
cases.scenario: A conceptual canal lacks donor-basin, ecological, geotechnical and rights evidence.
cases.oracle: Unknown water, rights or ecology evidence cannot be imputed as positive feasibility.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Aggregate performance hides group service-floor breach
cases.scenario: Aggregate tonnage improves but one beneficiary group falls below its service floor.
cases.oracle: Evaluate group-by-service outcomes, not only regional freight totals.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Mode comparison needs complete lifecycle ledgers
cases.scenario: Road, rail and multimodal alternatives have different lifecycle and externality profiles.
cases.oracle: Private, fiscal and social cost stay separate; rights and safety floors cannot be traded away.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: OD demand matrix missing or inconsistent
cases.scenario: Origin-destination volumes are incomplete or cover mismatched periods/commodities.
cases.oracle: Do not backfill missing freight demand with assumed totals.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Cargo-dues series differs from design capacity
cases.scenario: Monthly invoiced cargo statistics are not equivalent to design capacity or rail throughput.
cases.oracle: Metric identity, unit, period and definition stay attached to every value.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Superseded rail network statement
cases.scenario: A 2024/25 statement is used for a 2026/27 access claim without checking later revisions.
cases.oracle: Dated reference data cannot silently become current access conditions.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Compound port, rail and power disruption
cases.scenario: Overlapping outages require shared crews and prerequisite restoration.
cases.oracle: Do not add independent outage effects or assume shared-resource repairs can run in parallel.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: No-probability robust corridor choice
cases.scenario: Select a portfolio across three admissible futures without invented probabilities.
cases.oracle: Compute scenario-wise regret and minimize its maximum; no probabilities are used.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic corridor semantics only; no observed South African route capacity, project feasibility or engineering result.

cases.title: Route bottleneck across section-level operational capacity
cases.scenario: A four-section route has different operational train-path capacity at daily resolution. The weakest section limits the end-to-end route.
cases.oracle: For one serial route, route capacity is the minimum section operational capacity; delivered=min(demand,route capacity).

cases.title: Allocated versus spare capacity
cases.scenario: The source declares spare capacity as the residual after allocations from available operational capacity.
cases.oracle: Under the fixture's explicit definition, spare=available_operational-allocated.

cases.title: Theoretical, practical and capacity-lost values remain distinct
cases.scenario: A route section exposes theoretical capacity, practical capacity and reasons for lost capacity. The parser must preserve source semantics and not silently infer arithmetic when source definitions do not state it.
cases.oracle: The source-specific fields remain separate; numerical difference is not proof that the declared loss field has the same definition.

cases.title: Daily versus weekly train-path resolution
cases.scenario: The source declares four available paths per operating day and five operating days in the stated week.
cases.oracle: Weekly paths=paths per operating day multiplied by the declared five operating days, not seven calendar days.

cases.title: Two routes share a downstream section bottleneck
cases.scenario: Two feeder paths enter a common downstream section; their nominal capacities must not be summed beyond the shared section's capacity.
cases.oracle: Aggregate incoming capacity is 14, but the common section limits end-to-end flow to 10.

cases.title: Allocated capacity is not automatically unused spare capacity
cases.scenario: An operator is allocated ten paths/day and operates six. The remaining four cannot be reclassified as spare without contract, release and timetable evidence.
cases.oracle: Actual operated paths and contractually allocated paths are separate states; unused allocations do not automatically become available spare.

cases.title: Scheduled and realized running time are separate measures
cases.scenario: A published scheduled path includes buffer time of 120 minutes; one synthetic observed trip takes 150 minutes.
cases.oracle: Observed-minus-scheduled=30 minutes for this one fixture; one observation is not a representative distribution.

cases.title: XLSM formulas and cached values without macro execution
cases.scenario: An official macro-enabled capacity workbook is ingested as data. VBA is never executed; formula text, cached values, sheet visibility and workbook bytes remain auditable.
cases.oracle: Parser must treat the workbook as an untrusted data container and preserve formula/cached-value distinctions.

cases.title: TRIM route data is not the complete South African rail network
cases.scenario: The TRIM network register excludes PRASA and other infrastructure managers. A downstream report attempts to label its graph as the entire national rail network.
cases.oracle: The source scope and exclusions must propagate to every map, route and coverage summary.

cases.title: Investment-plan or future operator target cannot become operational capacity
cases.scenario: An approved investment plan or expected operator start is promoted into current available paths before commissioning and observed operation.
cases.oracle: Planned investment or future service milestone is not commissioned, available or operated capacity.
